orgId.description: The ID of the organization to which this user belongs.

personId.description: A unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The email address of this user.

licenses.description: An array of license strings that are assigned to this user.

siteUrls.description: An array of `siteUrls` and their `accountType` that are assigned to this user.

pendingLicenses.description: An array of license strings that are in pending state. This is only applicable to users outside the organization.

pendingSiteUrls.description: An array of `siteUrls` and their `accountType` that are in pending state. This is only applicable to users outside the organization.
